name: Access Request Pre-Check - Risk analysis and SOD
description: Access Request Submitted event-trigger wrapper. Runs custom:evaluate-access-request once (risk plus in-flight SoD), waits for the result account, branches on persisted attributes, and answers the trigger once. Decision Variables start approved with a placeholder comment. One step per risk tier, plus one step for a detected violation, override that decision and rewrite the comment from the findings. Those four steps are the whole policy. Import disabled, set Configuration, then subscribe the event trigger to this workflow external URL as Async.

Set Evaluation Failed.description: Every failed token or invoke lands here, as does a missing or unknown risk tier.

End Success.description: The Access Request Submitted callback was sent.

Callback Approved.description: Sends the approval to the trigger. The decision is a hardcoded boolean: a path substitution renders it as the string "true" or "false", which the trigger rejects.

Callback Denied.description: Sends the denial to the trigger. The decision is a hardcoded boolean: a path substitution renders it as the string "true" or "false", which the trigger rejects.

Check Approved.description: Picks the callback that carries the matching literal. Splitting the send is the only way to put a real boolean in the body, since the decision cannot be templated in as one. Update Variable stores the decision as the string "true" or "false", so it is compared as a string here.

Call Evaluate Access Request.description: One invoke runs risk scoring and preventive SoD concurrently. waitForPersist defaults to true so the result account is indexed before Get Accounts. evaluateSod is true for the pre-check path.

Read Precheck Result.description: Reads the verified result account written by custom:evaluate-access-request.
